content.text: None of the new images I tried in Float today looked right. The new SPHEREx images looked very grainy and every other image was all treated the same and look like flat artwork. There are wide images that have been cut off as well, instead of wrapping.

That's the headset-pass verdict on the untuned auto-placed batch — let me dig into the pipeline to figure out what's causing each of the three problems (SPHEREx grain, uniform flat-artwork look, cut-off wide images) before proposing fixes.

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Generate deepsky_auto.json: a deepsky_pipeline manifest row for every sky-worthy
3	image in _raw/potm (the ESA/Webb POTM + hand-picked pulls, see scripts/fetch_potm.py).
4	
5	Classification is keyword-on-title (planet > field > object, first match wins), with
6	first-guess placement params per class — same philosophy as the hand-tuned MANIFEST
7	rows: they render fine and get nudged on device. Engineering/PR shots (rocket liftoff,
8	detector mosaics, side-by-side comparisons) are skipped outright.
9	
10	Also emits deepsky_auto_catalog.swift — the SpatialImageEnvironment.catalog lines —
11	so the Swift registry can be pasted, not hand-typed.
12	
13	Run:  python3 upscale/potm_auto_manifest.py     # rewrites both outputs, prints a table
14	"""
15	import html
16	import json
17	import os
18	import re
19	
20	from PIL import Image
21	
22	HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
23	REPO = os.path.dirname(HERE)
24	POTM = os.path.join(REPO, "Float/Resources/Textures/_raw/potm")
25	MANIFEST = os.path.join(POTM, "potm_manifest.json")
26	OUT_JSON = os.path.join(HERE, "deepsky_auto.json")
27	OUT_SWIFT = os.path.join(HERE, "deepsky_auto_catalog.swift")
28	
29	Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
30	
31	# Non-sky imagery: engineering, alignment, PR. Never scenes.
32	SKIP = {
33	    "potm2201a": "rocket liftoff photo",
34	    "potm2202a": "mirror-alignment detector mosaic",
35	    "potm2205a": "MIRI/Spitzer side-by-side comparison panel",
36	    "potm2206":  "FGS engineering test mosaic",
37	}
38	
39	PLANET_KW = ("saturn", "jupiter", "uranus", "neptune", "titan ")
40	FIELD_KW = ("nebula", "cloud", "cliffs", "pillars", "region", "complex", "perseus",
41	            "sagittarius", "rho ophiuchi", "dust", "n79", "star-forming", "star formation",
42	            "nursery", "serpens", "orion", "carina", "tarantula", "chamaeleon", "digel",
43	            "protostar", "westerlund", "ism", "hourglass", "l1527", "herbig")
44	# params per class — fields fill the forward view, objects hang in the void (§ deepsky
45	# pipeline docstring; numbers bracket the device-approved hand-tuned rows).
46	PARAMS = {
47	    "planet": dict(fov_x=45,  lon=0, lat=0, feather=0.12, exposure=0.2),
48	    "field":  dict(fov_x=130, lon=0, lat=0, feather=0.30, exposure=0.35),
49	    "object": dict(fov_x=85,  lon=0, lat=0, feather=0.14, exposure=0.25),
50	}
51	
52	
53	def classify(title):
54	    t = title.lower()
55	    if any(k in t for k in PLANET_KW):
56	        return "planet"
57	    if any(k in t for k in FIELD_KW):
58	        return "field"
59	    return "object"
60	
61	
62	def main():
63	    with open(MANIFEST) as f:
64	        entries = json.load(f)
65	    rows, skipped = [], []
66	    for e in entries:
67	        pid = e["id"]
68	        title = html.unescape(e["title"]).strip()
69	        if pid in SKIP:
70	            skipped.append((pid, SKIP[pid]))
71	            continue
72	        ext = os.path.splitext(e["url"].split("?")[0])[1] or ".tif"
73	        src = os.path.join(POTM, pid + ext)
74	        if not os.path.exists(src):
75	            skipped.append((pid, "file missing"))
76	            continue
77	        with Image.open(src) as im:
78	            w, h = im.size
79	        cls = classify(title)
80	        kind = "object" if cls == "planet" else cls
81	        p = dict(PARAMS[cls])
82	        if cls == "field" and h > w * 1.1:
83	            p["rot"] = 1          # vertically-composed field -> horizontal nebula bank
84	        rows.append({"name": f"spatial_{pid}", "rel": f"../potm/{pid}{ext}",
85	                     "kind": kind, "params": p, "title": title})
86	        print(f"{pid:<30} {cls:<7} {w}x{h}  {title[:58]}")
87	
88	    with open(OUT_JSON, "w") as f:
89	        json.dump(rows, f, indent=1)
90	
91	    with open(OUT_SWIFT, "w") as f:
92	        f.write("// Auto-generated by upscale/potm_auto_manifest.py — POTM catalog entries.\n")
93	        for r in rows:
94	            t = r["title"].replace('"', "'")
95	            t = re.sub(r"\s*\((?:NIRCam|MIRI)[^)]*\)$", "", t)  # trim instrument suffixes
96	            if len(t) > 44:
97	                t = t[:43].rstrip() + "…"
98	            f.write(f'        .init(name: "{r["name"]}", title: "{t}", grounded: false),\n')
99	
100	    print(f"\n{len(rows)} rows -> {OUT_JSON}")
101	    for pid, why in skipped:
102	        print(f"SKIPPED {pid}: {why}")
103	
104	
105	if __name__ == "__main__":
106	    main()

2	"""Deep-sky masters -> spatial scene HEICs, via gnomonic compositing onto the star plate.
3	
4	The spatial app is equirect-only (every scene is a 2:1 stereo sphere), but the deep-sky
5	masters in _raw/deepsky/ are FLAT framed astrophotos (a galaxy fills a small slice of real
6	sky, not 360). Feeding one straight to the equirect pipeline would squash a square Carina to
7	2:1. So this adds a COMPOSE stage ahead of the existing depth->stereo->pack:
8	
9	  1. compose  — project the flat master onto a tangent plane at a chosen sky position
10	                (center_lon/lat) and horizontal FOV, gnomonic (rectilinear) so straight
11	                structure doesn't bow, edge-feather it, and ADD it (in linear light) over
12	                the dimmed Deep Star Map equirect. Additive is physically right for emission
13	                on black: dark sky adds nothing so the real stars show through untouched, and
14	                there's no alpha matte to clip the faint galaxy halo. -> mono 2:1 equirect PNG.
15	  2. stereo    — the EXISTING deepspace recipe (synth_pack): near-uniform vergence
16	                (depth_floor 0.94, smooth 0.07, baseline 0.22%, cos^2 poles). Proven on device
17	                to fuse; keeps a whisper of relief. No V100/comfy dependency (luminance depth).
18	  3. pack      — pack_spatial.swift -> Backdrop/spatial_<name>.heic + Thumbnails/<name>.jpg.
19

21	FOV / lon / feather / exposure on device. A depth-enhanced variant (DA V2 relief on the
22	pillars) is a possible follow-up A/B but needs the comfy/V100 path — deliberately NOT the
23	default here.

98	def load_base_linear(w, h):

112	
113	def load_master_linear(rel, rot=0):
114	    """Master as linear RGB, long side capped at MASTER_CAP. `rot` = CCW quarter-turns —
115	    these masters are all ~square or landscape, so rotation reorients vertically-composed
116	    CONTENT (e.g. a towering pillar becomes a horizontal nebula bank); it doesn't change

118	    im = open_rgb(os.path.join(DEEPSKY, rel))

129	def _smoothstep(t):
130	    t = np.clip(t, 0.0, 1.0)
131	    return t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)
132

134	def _bilinear(src, u, v):
135	    """Bilinear sample src[H,W,3] at float coords (u=x, v=y); out-of-range -> 0."""
136	    H, W = src.shape[:2]
137	    x0 = np.floor(u).astype(np.int64); y0 = np.floor(v).astype(np.int64)
138	    x1 = x0 + 1; y1 = y0 + 1
139	    fx = (u - x0)[..., None]; fy = (v - y0)[..., None]
140	    def g(xx, yy):
141	        ok = (xx >= 0) & (xx < W) & (yy >= 0) & (yy < H)
142	        xc = np.clip(xx, 0, W - 1); yc = np.clip(yy, 0, H - 1)
143	        return src[yc, xc] * ok[..., None]
144	    top = g(x0, y0) * (1 - fx) + g(x1, y0) * fx
145	    bot = g(x0, y1) * (1 - fx) + g(x1, y1) * fx
146	    return top * (1 - fy) + bot * fy

148	
149	def _add_layer(base, master, lon0_deg, lat0_deg, fov_x_deg, feather, gain=1.0, lum_key=False,
150	               proj="gnomonic"):
151	    """Project `master` onto the equirect `base` (linear light, additive).
152	
153	    proj="gnomonic": tangent plane — straight structure stays straight, but off-axis it IS
154	    a flat plane ("extends out flat" on device) and edge scale blows up 1/cos^2 (15x at a
155	    150-deg field's edge — the "pixelated" report). Kept for narrow objects (approved look).
156	    proj="equidistant": azimuthal equidistant — uniform angular scale wraps the image around
157	    the viewer, so wide fields curve like a surrounding cloud bank and keep pixel density to
158	    the edge. Nebulae have no straight lines, so the bowing gnomonic avoids is invisible.
159	    """
160	    h, w = base.shape[:2]
161	    sh, sw = master.shape[:2]
162	
163	    lon0 = np.radians(lon0_deg); lat0 = np.radians(lat0_deg)
164	    halfx_ang = np.radians(fov_x_deg) / 2.0          # angular half-width, both projections
165	    if proj == "gnomonic":
166	        xmax = np.tan(halfx_ang)                     # tangent-plane half-width
167	    else:
168	        xmax = halfx_ang                             # plane coords ARE angles
169	    ymax = xmax * (sh / sw)                          # square pixels -> half-height by aspect
170	
171	    # Restrict work to the equirect window the object can touch (+ margin for feather/curve).
172	    half_lon = halfx_ang * 1.15 + np.radians(4)
173	    half_lat = halfx_ang * (sh / sw) * 1.15 + np.radians(4)
174	    c_col = int((lon0 / (2 * np.pi) + 0.5) * w)
175	    c_row = int((0.5 - lat0 / np.pi) * h)
176	    dcol = min(int(np.ceil(half_lon / (2 * np.pi) * w)), w // 2)
177	    drow = int(np.ceil(half_lat / np.pi * h))
178	    r0, r1 = max(0, c_row - drow), min(h, c_row + drow)
179	    cols = np.mod(np.arange(c_col - dcol, c_col + dcol), w)     # wrap-safe column indices
180	
181	    lon = (cols / w - 0.5) * 2 * np.pi                          # [-pi, pi)
182	    lat = (0.5 - np.arange(r0, r1) / h) * np.pi                 # +pi/2 .. -pi/2
183	    LON, LAT = np.meshgrid(lon, lat)
184	    dlon = LON - lon0
185	
186	    cosc = np.sin(lat0) * np.sin(LAT) + np.cos(lat0) * np.cos(LAT) * np.cos(dlon)
187	    if proj == "gnomonic":
188	        front = cosc > 1e-6
189	        denom = np.where(front, cosc, 1.0)
190	    else:
191	        # k = c/sin(c) rescales the sine-based direction components to arc length.
192	        c = np.arccos(np.clip(cosc, -1.0, 1.0))
193	        front = c < np.radians(160)                  # keep well clear of the antipode pole
194	        sinc = np.sin(c)
195	        denom = np.where(sinc > 1e-6, sinc / np.where(c > 1e-6, c, 1.0), 1.0)
196	    Xt = np.cos(LAT) * np.sin(dlon) / denom
197	    Yt = (np.cos(lat0) * np.sin(LAT) - np.sin(lat0) * np.cos(LAT) * np.cos(dlon)) / denom
198	
199	    inside = front & (np.abs(Xt) <= xmax) & (np.abs(Yt) <= ymax)
200	    u = (Xt / xmax * 0.5 + 0.5) * (sw - 1)
201	    v = (0.5 - Yt / ymax * 0.5) * (sh - 1)                      # +Yt = up = row 0
202	    samp = _bilinear(master, u, v)

204	    fx = _smoothstep((xmax - np.abs(Xt)) / (feather * xmax + 1e-9))
205	    fy = _smoothstep((ymax - np.abs(Yt)) / (feather * ymax + 1e-9))

211	        # luminance so only the object's own emission contributes and the frame dissolves into
212	        # the real stars. Gentle knee preserves the faint galaxy halo. NOT applied to fields —
213	        # there a luminance key would punch holes in the dark dust lanes that ARE the structure.
214	        Lm = 0.2126 * samp[..., 0] + 0.7152 * samp[..., 1] + 0.0722 * samp[..., 2]
215	        alpha = alpha * _smoothstep((Lm - 0.003) / (0.030 - 0.003))

152	def synth_pack(mono_png, depth_png, name, category):
153	    # Per-category stereo recipe (§9). Grounded: real DA V2 depth, 1.0% baseline (approved
154	    # on device), guided edge-snap. Deep-space: near-UNIFORM vergence (high depth floor +
155	    # heavy smoothing + gentle baseline) so the whole starfield shifts together and fuses like
156	    # the imported skies — per-feature luminance depth made stars "wildly different". Both use
157	    # the cos^2 pole falloff so looking up doesn't converge overhead (the zenith artifact).
158	    #
159	    # Deep-space tuning (device feedback, two rounds): the first uniform-vergence pass fused
160	    # well but the nebula relief cardboarded — bright masses popped onto a discrete near plane
161	    # sitting too close. Progressively flattened: floor 0.75→0.88→0.94 (shrinks near/far
162	    # separation to ~1.6px), baseline 0.30→0.22%, smoothing 0.03→0.07 (masses blend into a
163	    # continuous gradient, not layers). Kept a whisper of relief rather than going fully flat,
164	    # since the depth itself reads well — it was only the layering that was too strong.
165	    if category == "grounded":
166	        params = dict(baseline_frac=0.010, smooth_frac=0.0, pole_power=2.0, depth_floor=0.0)
167	    else:
168	        params = dict(baseline_frac=0.0022, smooth_frac=0.07, pole_power=2.0, depth_floor=0.94)
169	    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
170	        lp0, rp0 = synth(mono_png, depth_png, td, **params)
171	        lp, rp = lp0, rp0

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Plain-model neural SR on the ai/comfyui V100, for equirect sources below target res.

Rick's standing rule: sources below target are ALWAYS upscaled by neural inference —
there is no "never upscale past the source" (that uninvited cap caused the grainy
SPHEREx scenes). Model choice is whatever gives the best result; for equirect
starfield/all-sky sources that is RealESRGAN_x4plus by A/B (2026-07-24, vs NMKD-Siax /
UltraSharp / UltimateSDUpscale): faithful color on diffuse nebulosity (USDU shifts
hue + speckles), round clean stars (Siax/UltraSharp turn survey noise into worm
artifacts), no tile seams, and ~100x faster than diffusion. The USDU diffusion recipe
remains the choice for flat POTM masters (master_sr.py, device-approved parity).

Equirects are wrap-padded before SR so the lon +/-180 seam (directly behind the
viewer) stays continuous, then cropped back after the model pass. Downscaling to the
exact target after the 4x model pass is Lanczos — the rule governs upscaling only.

The workflow is mirrored in the ComfyUI web UI as "equirect_realesrgan_sr" for study.
"""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time

from PIL import Image

Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
NS = "ai"
MODEL = "RealESRGAN_x4plus.pth"
MODEL_SCALE = 4
WRAP_PAD = 64                       # px of left/right wrap context fed to the model


def _log(msg):
    print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] {msg}", flush=True)


def comfy_pod():
    out = subprocess.run(
        ["kubectl", "get", "pods", "-n", NS, "-l", "app=comfyui", "--no-headers",
         "-o", "custom-columns=:metadata.name"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    pod = out.stdout.strip().split("\n")[0]
    if not pod:
        raise RuntimeError("no comfyui pod found (is Ollama holding the GPU? check replicas)")
    return pod


def _workflow(input_filename, out_prefix):
    return {
        "1": {"class_type": "LoadImage", "inputs": {"image": input_filename}},
        "2": {"class_type": "UpscaleModelLoader", "inputs": {"model_name": MODEL}},
        "3": {"class_type": "ImageUpscaleWithModel",
              "inputs": {"upscale_model": ["2", 0], "image": ["1", 0]}},
        "4": {"class_type": "SaveImage",
              "inputs": {"filename_prefix": out_prefix, "images": ["3", 0]}},
    }


def _run_pod(pod, local_png, tag, out_png, timeout_s=1800):
    subprocess.run(["kubectl", "cp", local_png, f"{NS}/{pod}:/basedir/input/nsr_{tag}.png"],
                   check=True)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".json", delete=False) as tf:
        json.dump({"prompt": _workflow(f"nsr_{tag}.png", f"nsrout_{tag}")}, tf)
        wfp = tf.name
    try:
        subprocess.run(["kubectl", "cp", wfp, f"{NS}/{pod}:/tmp/nsr_{tag}.json"], check=True)
    finally:
        os.unlink(wfp)
    r = subprocess.run(["kubectl", "exec", "-n", NS, pod, "--", "bash", "-lc",
                        f"curl -s -m 15 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8188/prompt "
                        f"-H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @/tmp/nsr_{tag}.json"],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    if '"prompt_id"' not in r.stdout:
        raise RuntimeError(f"SR submit failed for {tag}: {r.stdout[:300]} {r.stderr[:200]}")
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < timeout_s:
        q = subprocess.run(["kubectl", "exec", "-n", NS, pod, "--", "bash", "-lc",
                            "curl -s -m 6 http://127.0.0.1:8188/queue"],
                           capture_output=True, text=True)
        try:
            d = json.loads(q.stdout)
            if len(d.get("queue_running", [])) + len(d.get("queue_pending", [])) == 0:
                break
        except Exception:
            pass
        time.sleep(4)
    ls = subprocess.run(["kubectl", "exec", "-n", NS, pod, "--", "bash", "-lc",
                         f"ls -t /basedir/output/nsrout_{tag}_*.png 2>/dev/null | head -1"],
                        capture_output=True, text=True)
    remote = ls.stdout.strip()
    if not remote:
        raise RuntimeError(f"no SR output for {tag}")
    subprocess.run(["kubectl", "cp", f"{NS}/{pod}:{remote}", out_png], check=True)


def sr_equirect(im, tag, target_w):

    for lid, (s, ss, d, ds, t) in enumerate(links_spec, start=1):
        links.append([lid, s, ss, d, ds, t])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Remove scenes from the shipping library (the triage-page 'remove' batch).

Per scene: deletes Backdrop/<name>.heic + Thumbnails/<name>.jpg + any local
_raw/potm_sr/<pid>.png, drops the SpatialImageEnvironment.catalog entry, drops the
deepsky_auto.json row, removes single-line MANIFEST tuples in deepsky_pipeline.py /
process_backdrops.py, and records the id in upscale/pruned_scenes.json so a future
potm_auto_manifest.py regeneration cannot resurrect it. NEVER touches the originals
archive on /Volumes/Logic Pro — pruned scenes can always be rebuilt from there.

Run:  python3 scripts/prune_scenes.py spatial_potm2603a potm2211a ...
      python3 scripts/prune_scenes.py --file removed.txt   # one name per line
Then: python3 scripts/make_triage_page.py                  # refresh the triage page
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
REPO = os.path.dirname(HERE)
BACKDROP = os.path.join(REPO, "Float/Resources/Textures/Backdrop")
THUMBS = os.path.join(BACKDROP, "Thumbnails")
SR_DIR = os.path.join(REPO, "Float/Resources/Textures/_raw/potm_sr")
CATALOG = os.path.join(REPO, "Float/Immersive/SpatialImageEnvironment.swift")
AUTO = os.path.join(REPO, "upscale/deepsky_auto.json")
PRUNED = os.path.join(REPO, "upscale/pruned_scenes.json")
PY_MANIFESTS = [os.path.join(REPO, "upscale/deepsky_pipeline.py"),
                os.path.join(REPO, "upscale/process_backdrops.py")]


def rm(path, log):
    if os.path.exists(path):
        os.remove(path)
        log.append(f"  rm {os.path.relpath(path, REPO)}")


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("names", nargs="*")
    ap.add_argument("--file", help="file with one scene name per line")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    names = list(args.names)
    if args.file:
        names += [ln.strip() for ln in open(args.file) if ln.strip()]
    names = ["spatial_" + n if not n.startswith("spatial_") else n for n in names]
    if not names:
        ap.error("no scene names given")

    cat = open(CATALOG).read()
    auto = json.load(open(AUTO))
    pruned = json.load(open(PRUNED)) if os.path.exists(PRUNED) else []
    pys = {p: open(p).read() for p in PY_MANIFESTS}

    for name in names:
        pid = name.removeprefix("spatial_")
        log = [f"{name}:"]
        rm(os.path.join(BACKDROP, f"{name}.heic"), log)
        rm(os.path.join(THUMBS, f"{name}.jpg"), log)
        rm(os.path.join(SR_DIR, f"{pid}.png"), log)

        cat, n = re.subn(rf'[ \t]*\.init\(name: "{re.escape(name)}",[^\n]*\n', "", cat)
        if n:
            log.append(f"  catalog entry removed ({n})")
        before = len(auto)
        auto = [r for r in auto if r["name"] != name]
        if len(auto) != before:
            log.append("  deepsky_auto.json row removed")
        for p in pys:
            pys[p], n = re.subn(rf'[ \t]*\("{re.escape(name)}",[^\n]*\n', "", pys[p])
            if n:
                log.append(f"  {os.path.basename(p)} MANIFEST row removed")
        if pid not in pruned:
            pruned.append(pid)
        print("\n".join(log))

    open(CATALOG, "w").write(cat)
    json.dump(auto, open(AUTO, "w"), indent=1)
    json.dump(sorted(pruned), open(PRUNED, "w"), indent=1)
    for p, src in pys.items():
        open(p, "w").write(src)
    print(f"\n{len(names)} scene(s) pruned; ids recorded in upscale/pruned_scenes.json")
    print("Originals remain in the archive on /Volumes/Logic Pro (untouched).")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
